method: each Gaia DR3 position (epoch 2016.0) moved in a straight line with its proper motion to the frame's MJD; parallax not applied; stars without a Gaia proper motion stay at their 2016.0 position
pixel_convention: PNG pixels: x to the right (west), y down (south), 0 = centre of the first pixel
target_match_rule: the Gaia star nearest the grid centre at 2026.0, if within 3.0″
data_credit: ESA Gaia DR3, via NASA/IPAC IRSA
